author: Chao-Jen Huang (ephoton)
title: Cellview Creation
description: The schema validates the minimum requirements for cell view

$schema.description: The schema of the cellview replacement configuration.

release.description: The release date of the cellview. Date format is "yyyy/mm/dd".

library.description: Default imported library name. This field will be overridden by the category's library name setting.

debugMode.description: Enable debug mode. The default value is false.

database.description: Define how a cellview is created.

cell.description: Define cell name. The cell name can be combined with # symbol to create different designs.

searchDir.description: Specify the relative or absolute path to the folder where VerilogA files are stored. Used when each cell has its own .va file (e.g., cellName.va).

moduleFile.description: Specify a single VerilogA file to be used for all cells. When specified, this overrides the searchDir behavior. The file path can be relative or absolute.

deleteParameter.description: List of CDF parameter names to be deleted when method is 'update'. Parameters are deleted before new parameters are created or updated.

parameterOrder.description: Specify the order of CDF parameters. Supports three formats: simple array (full order mode), explicit full order mode, or insertion mode.

oneOf.description: Simple array format for full order mode (backward compatible). Parameters are ordered as listed, unlisted parameters are appended at the end.
Full order mode (explicit format). Complete control over parameter order.

order.description: List of parameter names in desired order

oneOf.description: Insertion mode. Only reposition specified parameters, others maintain original order.

positions.description: Map of parameter names to insertion positions

after.description: Insert after this parameter name. Use null to insert at beginning.

user.description: Define whether it is a user CDF parameter. The default value is false.

units.description: Define the unit to be displayed when the CDF parameter is a string type.

expand.description: If the CDF parameter contains the question symbol, the expand attribute can be used to expand the CDF parameter.

callback.description: If the callback content is directly entered, it will be fully displayed in the CDF callback field.

function.description: Define the callback function name without parentheses.

passAsSelfSymbol.description: If the callback function is defined in the CDF, it will be passed as a self symbol.

method.description: Method for CDF parameter handling: 'new' (always create new, delete if exists), 'update' (update if exists, skip if not), 'updateCreate' (update if exists, create if not)

creation_schematic_wire.description: Wire creation item for schematic view with coordinate, color, lineStyle, width, and optional label

creation_schematic_pin.description: Pin creation item for schematic view with name, direction, origin, orient, and optional instance

creation_schematic_noteShape.description: NoteShape creation item for schematic view with shape, style, coordinate, and optional label

startAngle.description: Start angle for arc/ellipse shapes (in degrees)

stopAngle.description: Stop angle for arc/ellipse shapes (in degrees)

creation_schematic_label.description: Independent label creation item for schematic view with text, origin, and formatting properties

items.description: The expanded cell name will replace the # symbol of the original cell name.

prefix.description: The prefix of the replaced expanded cell name.

suffix.description: The suffix of the replaced expanded cell name.

origin.description: The origin coordinates of the drawing.
The origin coordinates of the drawing.

width.description: If width is defined, wide line will be used for drawing. Otherwise narrow line will be used for drawing.
If width is defined, wide line will be used for drawing. Otherwise narrow line will be used for drawing.

horizontal.description: Draw horizontal pin connection length. The default value is 0.25.

vertical.description: Draw vertical pin connection length. The default value is 0.125.

fontHeight.description: Define the font height of label. The default font height is 0.0625.

left.description: Draw the left pin terminal using the horizontal pin connection length. The default direction is input and the default type is signal.

right.description: Draw the right pin terminal using the horizontal pin connection length. The default direction is output and the default type is signal.

top.description: Draw the top pin terminal using the vertical pin connection length. The default direction is inputOutput and the default type is power.

bottom.description: Draw the bottom pin terminal using the vertical pin connection length. The default direction is inputOutput and the default type is ground.

separator.description: The horizontal line that defines the body

hidePinName.description: The pin name is not displayed. The default value is false.

offset.description: Define the relative position of the first pin terminal from the body. The default value of horizontal pins is [ 0.0, -0.125 ]. The default value for vertical pins is to be placed in the middle of the body and aligned to the left of the 0.0625 grid point.

shift.description: Define the relative position between the next pin terminal and the previous pin terminal. The default value is [ 0.0, -0.125 ].

labelShift.description: Define the relative position of the label from the pin terminal. The default value is [ 0.0, 0.0 ].

hidePinName.description: The pin name is not displayed. The default value is false.

group.description: Define a creation group item for reuse.

name.description: Define creation group name, apply in groups field.

creation.description: Array of creation items for wires, pins, and labels

instance.description: Object with instance names as keys

textDisplay.description: Text display configuration for instance (single or array)

settings.description: Global settings for schematic view creation

creation_schematicTextDisplay.description: Text display configuration for schematic instance
